opqrst_provocation.text: What makes it better or worse?

opqrst_quality.text: Can you describe what it feels like?

opqrst_severity.text: On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is it?

opqrst_timing.text: Is it constant or does it come and go?

safety_q1.text: In the past month, have you wished you were dead?

safety_q2.text: Have you had thoughts of killing yourself?

specialty_notes.dermatology: How long has the rash been present? Any new products or exposures?
specialty_notes.cardiology: Any family history of heart disease? Any prior ECG or cardiac tests?
specialty_notes.psychiatry: Use PHQ-2 and GAD-2; do not ask radiation question.
